customManagers.description: Grafana Alloy in the loki_journal app: the Dockerfile downloads the .deb attached to the GitHub release v<ALLOY_VERSION>

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: weekly, like Dependabot did
Leave runner labels and action version inputs alone, Dependabot never updated those

Home Assistant's own actions that follow a branch (like home-assistant/actions@master) float on purpose. Pinning them would open a digest PR for each change to them. Their actions on a version tag are pinned like any other.
Grafana Alloy: wait a few days after a release, then automerge minor and patch updates once the version-bump workflow has bumped the app version and the checks pass
App updates need a version bump and a changelog entry, which Renovate can't write
prBodyNotes: The `Renovate version bump` workflow bumps `version` in `loki_journal/config.yaml` and adds a matching entry to `loki_journal/CHANGELOG.md` on this pull request. Check that its commit is there before merging; merging publishes the new image tag.
